title: Jesus... My Father Is In The ICU And I Can't Get There
topic: father in the ICU while he is stuck in another city

bible.text: Do not fear, for I am with you; do not be afraid, for I am your God. I will strengthen you; I will surely help you; I will uphold you with My righteous right hand.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... my father is in the ICU and I'm stuck in another city. The next train is tomorrow night. 😭

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Mom keeps saying "don't worry." Her voice is shaking.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: I'm in that ICU right now. I'm beside your father, and I'm beside you.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: What if something happens before I get there?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You can't be in two places. I can. Let Me be where you can't.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I don't even know how to pray right now.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Then just say his name to Me. I'll know the rest.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Call your mother back. Be strong for her, and let Me be strong for you.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Type a prayer for every father in a hospital tonight. 🙏
